adherence_audit.method: Manual semantic review of all 48 first ordinary story notes against the required prior-priority, evidence-or-unknown, and current-priority routine. No exact phrase was required. Ambiguous narrative follow-through was not credited as an unambiguous complete checkpoint. This audits written evidence, not hidden reasoning.
adherence_audit.quarterly_priority_carry_forward: Not reliably demonstrated; monthly priorities were usually unclear. Some quarterly notes did respond to formal feedback and survival needs.
adherence_audit.tool_call_deduplication: Tool-call IDs deduplicated across streamed wrappers; call and result kinds kept separate.
